message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine correct label(s) for this case. Facts: Li Mou (parent) helps his son Li Mou Jia, who is a criminal, to evade police, gives money to escape, shelters him at home, provides false identity for medical treatment, pays medical fees, etc. This is "窝藏罪" (concealing a criminal). The correction lessons mention: "Correct label 【窝藏、包庇;包庇毒品犯罪分子】 (not 「[罪名]制造毒品<eoa>」): 关键在于行为人是为制毒嫌疑人提供住所、工具等帮助，属于窝藏、包庇，而不是亲自制造毒品。若事实仅描述帮助、隐匿或包庇毒品犯罪分子，则应判定为“窝藏、包庇;包庇毒品犯罪分子”。" But here it's not drug crime, it's general criminal. So label should be "窝藏、包庇". The example earlier: "事实: ... 公诉机关认为...应当以窝藏罪追究其刑事责任。" So label is "窝藏、包庇". The correction lessons also have "Correct label 【故意伤害;妨害作证】 (not 「[罪名]故意伤害;伪证<eoa>」)" etc. Not relevant.

Thus answer: [罪名]窝藏、包庇<eoa>

Check if any other crimes: He gave 400 yuan to help escape, but that's part of concealment. No other crimes like bribery. So single label.
